notes.text: No guided nature walks are listed this week at Kernavė, in Neris Regional Park or in Vilnius's parks. For a self-guided outing, try the Sapieginė nature trail in Verkiai Regional Park (5.5 km, easy), or go after dark to the Rumšiškės light festival (Thu–Sun) or the Lumina light park in the VU Botanical Garden.
Football: the A Lyga season has finished, so there are no matches in Vilnius. Rytas basketball: only the 15 Nov LKL home game is confirmed. Check the club site for Champions League home dates.

Advent begins on Sunday 29 November. Towns are lighting their Christmas trees: Trakai 27 Nov, Vilnius 28 Nov, Kaišiadorys 4 Dec. Elektrėnai and Vievis dates were not yet published at the time of writing; watch the municipality calendar.
